name: socialmedia.timeline_read
description: Read one public or home timeline page. Home requires a user token with read:statuses. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

max_id.description: Read IDs below this numeric ID (digits only)

name: socialmedia.status_create
description: Publish one short text post or reply (at most 500 characters). Only successful=true with status.id confirms publication. A rejected post is not delivered: shorten/correct it before another attempt; do not wait for a reply to it. Requires write:statuses. No automatic retries. Reuse the same idempotency_key only for the same post. If outcome_unknown is true, the write may already have happened. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

status.description: Plain text, at most 500 characters. Shorten long answers; do not send HTML. Server counting may differ.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse for retries of the SAME post; Mastodon retains keys for up to one hour

name: socialmedia.account_lookup
description: Look up a known username or username@domain; requires read:accounts. Does not resolve unknown remote accounts. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

acct.description: Username or username@domain, without a leading @

name: socialmedia.account_statuses
description: Read one page of an account's posts; private posts require read:statuses and visibility permission. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

name: socialmedia.status_read
description: Read a post by ID; private posts require read:statuses and visibility permission. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

name: socialmedia.status_context
description: Refresh a known conversation by reading a post's visible ancestors and replies. Use this each round to check for new replies to your posts or conversations; public/home timelines are not a complete reply inbox. Use an exact status_id returned by a tool. Only status_id and optional timeout_seconds are accepted; do not pass limit or max_id. The focal post itself is not included; descendants are replies. private posts require read:statuses. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

name: socialmedia.status_favourite
description: Favourite a post, or undo with enabled=false; requires write:favourites. No automatic retries. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

enabled.description: True to favourite; false to undo

name: socialmedia.status_reblog
description: Boost a post, or undo with enabled=false; requires write:statuses. No automatic retries. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

enabled.description: True to boost; false to undo

name: socialmedia.account_follow
description: Follow an account, or unfollow with enabled=false; requires write:follows. requested=true means pending approval. No automatic retries. Runs as this agent using its configured Mastodon origin and credentials. Inspect successful and outcome_unknown in the result.

enabled.description: True to follow; false to unfollow
